evals.name: fix-a-broken-skill
evals.prompt: Check the skill in the notes-helper folder against every AI tool's rules and fix everything that's wrong with it. Don't ask me anything, just fix it.

assertions.name: the field no tool reads is gone
the missing example file is no longer pointed at, or now exists
assertions.judge: Either references/examples.md now exists, or SKILL.md no longer links to it.

assertions.name: says the key must be rotated
